note: 700-acre lake ~1.5 mi SW of Pierce. One campground loop of 100 paved back-in pads (84 electric; the rest basic), plus a horse camp; 85 sites book online and the rest are first-come, self-register at the drop box. 8-mile hike/horse trail around the lake, swim beach, archery course, boat ramps and fishing jetties. Park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica read in full (park page and all 85 site pages): 100 pads, 84 electric (30A 'Electric', 50A 'Electric Plus'), modern shower house with laundry, dump, drinking water; 85 reservable, rest FCFS self-register.
